{{Top|leg}}
A '''holochart''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] system used to project charts and diagrams that were placed on a wall and could be drawn or written on using a [[Stylus/Legends|stylus]]. Holocharts were used to display arrivals and departures from [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], along as within military bases, showing troop movements.
